payload.name: Indirect meeting search for role questions
payload.description: Apply when a question asks when or how a person met a role-identified person (future wife, spouse) and direct role-based queries return no evidence; search the person's name with meeting/trip terms and inspect event memories.
content: Before answering 'no information', if the question asks when or how a person met a role-identified person (future wife, spouse, partner), retry retrieval with the person's name plus broad terms: met, met someone, trip, vacation, encounter, woman.

Treat an event memory about a meeting or trip (e.g., 'met an amazing Canadian woman on a trip') as relevant evidence even if it omits the role label; use its world_start or the message timestamp to answer when.
Stop after two or three such targeted searches if no meeting event appears; do not exhaustively expand.

solves: The failure mechanism is that relational labels (future wife, spouse) in the question do not match event memories that describe the meeting indirectly (e.g., 'met an amazing woman on a trip'). Future pattern: 'when did X meet his/her wife/partner' with no explicit role in stored events. Applies when the event lacks the role label; not when the event explicitly states the role or the question already contains the date.
